_note: Example profile, shaped after a real Django project. Every value here is a project-specific choice: replace them with your own. Portable principles live in SKILL.md and do not belong here. See ADAPTING.md.

config_locations.black: none (runs on defaults; do not add [tool.black])

imports.policy: top-of-module only; refactor circular imports rather than dodging them inline
accepted_inline_exceptions: optional or heavy dependency behind a feature check

docs.function_docs: triple-quoted docstring as the first statement; # comments only inline within a body
docs.empty_init_files: give them a one-line module docstring instead of leaving them zero-byte

dependencies.policy: prefer a maintained library over hand-rolled equivalents; flag openly when none fits
dependencies.maintained_means: release within ~2 years and current Django major supported

queries.policy: related data is fetched where the queryset is built; every view that renders a list ships with a query-count test
queries.detection_in_tests: pytest-django django_assert_num_queries, plus a does-not-scale assertion via CaptureQueriesContext
queries.lazy_load_guard: django-zen-queries queries_disabled() around template render, or false when the project has none
queries.queryset_helpers: <app>/querysets.py or a Manager method, for shapes needed by three or more call sites
queries.alerting: whatever APM the project runs, treated as a backstop rather than as detection
queries.do_not_add: a detection package the project has not adopted, as a side effect of fixing one view

permissions.known_deviation: name any design doc or helper in this project that checks groups directly, so it is not followed by accident; grant-side helpers are unaffected
permissions.object_level: can_access_<thing>(user, obj) checking owner_id / collaborators is a data-model check and is fine

secrets.key_required_when: DEBUG off; derived from SECRET_KEY in DEBUG for dev convenience
secrets.human_storage: 1Password (name yours here; do not suggest a wiki or notes app, even where older project docs do)

frontend.page_conventions: the project-local UI skill or doc, if any; null when the project has none

workflow.activate_venv: never; call ./venv/bin/<tool> directly or use the container runner
workflow.local_loop: run tests; do not run formatters or linters as a sanity pass
workflow.before_pr: autofix then check, because CI runs tests and lint
workflow.git: stage only; never commit, push, or open a PR unless explicitly asked

deployment.target: Azure App Service, container pulled from GHCR
deployment.boot_contract: entrypoint runs migrate then gunicorn on $PORT; whitenoise serves static
deployment.dev_services: docker compose postgres + redis on per-project host ports, never host Postgres

email.sanitizer_available: <app>.templatetags.<module>.safe_markdown (bleach; whitelist p br strong em a code ul ol li), or false
email.second_impl: a second app following the same shape, if one exists
